conflicts: Compendium and Clarity describe distance-dependent delay without a formula. Foundry represents a fixed .2 second PvE / zero PvP delay. Do not substitute that constant for a measured distance curve.
Clarity reports possible 1-2 percent PvP precision variation; the supplied split formula is exact only before native rounding and specific bow calibration.
policies: Before firing capture both damage snapshots, payload fraction/radius/scale. On contact use the saved muzzle and exact collision position as Euclidean distance input to the required meter-to-second delay profile. This distance metric and sampling boundary are explicit Chorus policy, not original-game measurements.

No payload skips the delay-profile query. A negative delay is diagnosed before creating an attachment or issuing damage. Nonnegative delay is rounded up to whole microseconds using decimal arithmetic; exactly zero executes the contact blast without a timer.

Damage group and entity attachment lifetime equal accepted delay plus one second, then close after blast or unavailable diagnostic. This supports independently queued long fuses rather than imposing a universal one-second fuse limit.

Entity contact uses the prior attachment policies: death FOLLOW, destroyed/removed FIX, unloaded/transferred END. Block contacts retain the physical surface. A fixed old center does not follow a same-UUID new life, which may still be a normal radial target.

Bow reference uses synthetic body10/precision2, projectile speed100/no gravity, ammo and trigger interval. It does not borrow hand-cannon range attenuation or the Legendary hand-cannon PvP explosive penalty.
Synthetic delay curve: (0m,.1s),(5m,.2s),(15m,.4s),(30m,.7s), linear/clamped. Radial shape is synthetic linear. Neither curve is claimed as a measured Destiny curve.
